title: BrkRaw
description: Convert Bruker BioSpin ParaVision reconstructed 2dseq scans to NIfTI-1 with scrubbed JSON sidecars.

convert.title: Convert Bruker scan to NIfTI
convert.description: Inspect a Bruker ParaVision 5.1 or 6.0.1 study (.zip archive or study folder) and convert one selected scan/reconstruction to NIfTI-1 (.nii.gz) and a privacy-scrubbed BIDS-style JSON sidecar.

study.description: Bruker ParaVision study as a .zip archive or folder files containing acqp, method, visu_pars, and 2dseq

scanId.description: Bruker scan ID to convert (defaults to the first multi-slice or 3D anatomical scan when omitted).

slicePackIndex.description: Zero-based slice pack index for multi-pack acquisitions such as tri-pilot localizers.

space.description: Output NIfTI coordinate space matching BrkRaw v0.5.7.

subjectType.description: Optional subject type override (applies only when space is subject_ras).

subjectPose.description: Optional subject position override (applies only when space is subject_ras).
